about.title: About
about.desc: openkoutsi is an open-source endurance training companion. It lets you upload and analyse workouts from FIT files or Strava, track fitness metrics like Fitness, Fatigue and Form over time, manage heart rate and power zones, set goals, and generate personalised training plans — all from a self-hosted instance you control.

llm.title: AI / LLM
llm.desc: Connect your own LLM (e.g. a local {ollama} instance or an OpenAI-compatible API) to enable workout analysis and AI plan generation. All calls are proxied through the server — your API key is encrypted at rest and never sent to your browser.
llm.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. {ollamaUrl} for Ollama or {openaiUrl}
llm.serverRestricted: The server administrator has restricted LLM servers to this list.
llm.apiKeySet: API key is configured on the server.
llm.apiKeySetHint: Leave blank to keep current key, or type a new one to replace it.
llm.apiKeySecurityTitle: How is my API key stored?
llm.apiKeySecurityBody: Your API key is encrypted server-side using AES-256 (Fernet) with a key derived from your user ID via HKDF-SHA256. It is never returned to the browser after being saved — the server decrypts it in-memory only when making LLM requests on your behalf. All LLM calls are proxied through the backend, so your key and request data never leave your self-hosted instance.
llm.configured: LLM configured — workout analysis and AI plan generation are enabled.
llm.mixedContent: Mixed content warning: this page is served over HTTPS but your LLM URL starts with http://. The server will attempt server-to-server requests, but if your LLM is on localhost it must be reachable from the server process.
llm.testNoBaseUrl: Enter a base URL first before testing

tokens.title: Personal access tokens
tokens.desc: Long-lived, scoped credentials for your own tooling — a backup script, a cron job, a phone, or an AI client that talks to this instance from outside the app. A token can do less than you can: only what you grant it, never the admin area, your inbox or AI features.
tokens.copyOnce: Copy this token now. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved again.
tokens.copyOnceWarning: Treat it like a password: anything holding it can act on your data within the scopes you granted, until it expires or you revoke it.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.scopesDesc: Grant only what the tool actually needs. Scopes cannot be changed later — widening a token means revoking it and creating a new one.
tokens.exportWarning: This one call downloads your entire record, including your inbox. Every use is recorded in the server's audit log.
tokens.expiryDesc: Every token expires — there is no permanent one. You will be warned in your inbox 7 days and 1 day before, and again on the day.
tokens.empty: You have not created any tokens yet.
tokens.revokeConfirmDesc: “{name}” stops working immediately, and anything using it will start being refused. This cannot be undone — create a new token if you need one.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.autoAnalyzeDesc: Automatically generate AI coaching analysis when a workout is uploaded or synced. Requires an LLM configured by your team administrator.
analysis.autoTrainingStatusDesc: Automatically generate a daily training status overview on the dashboard after uploads and syncs. Requires an LLM configured by your team administrator.
analysis.agenticKoutsiDesc: Instead of being handed a fixed summary, Koutsi decides what it needs and looks it up — so it can follow a thread, like checking the rides behind a form number instead of just repeating it. This also unlocks Ask Koutsi, where you can put your own questions to it. Slower and uses more of the AI budget, and only works with models that support tool calling; the daily feedback falls back to the usual summary automatically, but chat needs it.
analysis.askForRpe: Ask me to rate effort after uploads
analysis.askForRpeDesc: After a significant cycling ride is uploaded or synced, prompt me on the dashboard to rate how hard it felt (RPE, 1–10).
analysis.gamificationDesc: Earn badges for milestones and track weekly streaks. Turn this off if you would rather train without them.
analysis.modelDesc: Which AI model to use for coaching.
analysis.patExpiryEmails: Email me before an access token expires
analysis.patExpiryEmailsDesc: Send an email 7 days and 1 day before a personal access token expires, and again on the day. The in-app notification is always sent.

commute.desc: Describe what your commute looks like and openkoutsi will suggest the commute label on rides that match. Suggestions are never applied on their own — you confirm each one. Rides you tick as a commute in Strava are labelled automatically.
